methodology.gross_aum: Primary Advisor inflows plus Secondary Advisor inflows for the reporting period. Outflows are not subtracted from Gross AUM.
methodology.weighted_pipeline: Opportunity AUM multiplied by the probability assigned to its current Salesforce stage, limited to opportunities expected to close by year-end.
methodology.projected_year_end: Gross AUM YTD plus weighted pipeline through December 31 of the reporting year.
methodology.percent_to_goal: Gross AUM YTD divided by the annual Gross AUM goal, expressed as a percentage.
methodology.projected_percent_to_goal: Projected year-end production divided by the annual Gross AUM goal, expressed as a percentage.
methodology.goal_outlook: On Track is projected at 100% or more of goal; Close (the dashboard's at-risk category) is 85% through 99.9%; Off Track is below 85%.
methodology.appointments: Completed advisor activities in the selected reporting period. Intro includes intro or discovery activity; Review includes completed review activity; weekly average is completed appointments divided by elapsed reporting weeks.
methodology.networking: Networking events recorded for the advisor in the selected reporting period. The annual scorecard target is derived from the advisor's weekly SMART goal.
methodology.household_roles: Primary is the originating advisor; Secondary is credited for eligible new money after assignment; Servicing is responsible for the ongoing relationship and reviews.
methodology.average_household_aum: Book AUM divided by household count for the applicable advisor role. The dashboard target is $500,000.
methodology.missing_values: A numeric zero means measured activity or value of zero. null means the value is unavailable from the current source. Fields are never omitted merely because they are zero or unavailable.
